package execmatch

import (
	"reflect"
	"testing"
)

func tighteningObserverTest(t *testing.T) {
	t.Helper()
	t.Setenv("TEGO_EXECMATCH_JOURNAL", t.TempDir())
	t.Setenv("TEGO_EXECMATCH_SIDE", "old")
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		tighteningJournal.Lock()
		defer tighteningJournal.Unlock()
		if tighteningJournal.file != nil {
			_ = tighteningJournal.file.Close()
			tighteningJournal.file = nil
		}
	})
}

func tighteningObserverSignature(ix *Index) string {
	ix.observeTightening(&Facts{Requested: "tool", Argv: []string{"tool"}}, Result{})
	return tighteningJournal.indexes[ix]
}

func tighteningObserverIndex(t *testing.T, rows *Rows, list List, opts IndexOptions) *Index {
	t.Helper()
	p, err := Parse("tool run", list, rows)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return NewIndex(rows, []*Pattern{p}, opts)
}

func TestTighteningObserverIgnoresCompiledState(t *testing.T) {
	tighteningObserverTest(t)
	rs := NewRows(&Row{Tool: "tool", Root: &Level{Subs: map[string]*Level{"run": {}}}})
	a := tighteningObserverIndex(t, rs, ListAllow, IndexOptions{})
	b := tighteningObserverIndex(t, rs, ListAllow, IndexOptions{})
	// These are implementation results, never supplied constructor inputs.
	b.mcNames = []string{"changed implementation output"}
	b.tools["tool"].constrained = !b.tools["tool"].constrained
	if tighteningObserverSignature(a) != tighteningObserverSignature(b) {
		t.Fatal("compiled implementation state changed the raw input key")
	}
}

func TestTighteningObserverSeparatesRawInputs(t *testing.T) {
	tighteningObserverTest(t)
	rows := func(alias string) *Rows {
		return NewRows(&Row{Tool: "tool", Names: []string{alias}, Root: &Level{Subs: map[string]*Level{"run": {}}}})
	}
	baseRows := rows("alias")
	base := tighteningObserverSignature(tighteningObserverIndex(t, baseRows, ListAllow, IndexOptions{}))
	cases := map[string]*Index{
		"custom row":      tighteningObserverIndex(t, rows("different"), ListAllow, IndexOptions{}),
		"deny permission": tighteningObserverIndex(t, baseRows, ListDeny, IndexOptions{}),
		"ask permission":  tighteningObserverIndex(t, baseRows, ListAsk, IndexOptions{}),
		"identity":        tighteningObserverIndex(t, baseRows, ListAllow, IndexOptions{Identities: map[ID]string{{Dev: 1, Ino: 2}: "tool"}}),
		"loader":          tighteningObserverIndex(t, baseRows, ListAllow, IndexOptions{Loaders: map[ID]bool{{Dev: 1, Ino: 2}: true}}),
		"implicit grant":  tighteningObserverIndex(t, baseRows, ListAllow, IndexOptions{Unconstrained: map[string]bool{"tool": true}}),
		"candidate names": tighteningObserverIndex(t, baseRows, ListAllow, IndexOptions{Candidates: NewCandidates([]string{"run"}, nil)}),
	}
	for name, ix := range cases {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			if tighteningObserverSignature(ix) == base {
				t.Fatal("different raw input collided")
			}
		})
	}
	a := tighteningObserverIndex(t, baseRows, ListAllow, IndexOptions{Candidates: NewCandidates([]string{"run"}, nil)})
	b := tighteningObserverIndex(t, baseRows, ListAllow, IndexOptions{Candidates: NewCandidates([]string{"run"}, []string{"run"})})
	if tighteningObserverSignature(a) == tighteningObserverSignature(b) {
		t.Fatal("candidate common group collided")
	}
	c := tighteningObserverIndex(t, baseRows, ListAllow, IndexOptions{Candidates: NewCandidates([]string{"run", "run"}, nil)})
	if tighteningObserverSignature(a) == tighteningObserverSignature(c) {
		t.Fatal("raw candidate constructor inputs were replaced by normalized outputs")
	}
}

func TestTighteningObserverBuiltinIdentityAndCustomSchema(t *testing.T) {
	tighteningObserverTest(t)
	makeRows := func(alias string) *Rows {
		return NewRows(&Row{Tool: "tool", Names: []string{alias}, Root: &Level{Subs: map[string]*Level{"run": {}}}})
	}
	a := tighteningObserverIndex(t, TighteningBuiltinRows(makeRows("old implementation")), ListAllow, IndexOptions{})
	b := tighteningObserverIndex(t, TighteningBuiltinRows(makeRows("new implementation")), ListAllow, IndexOptions{})
	if tighteningObserverSignature(a) != tighteningObserverSignature(b) {
		t.Fatal("builtin implementation data changed the raw input identity")
	}
	oldSchema := struct{ Tool string }{Tool: "tool"}
	newSchema := struct {
		Tool      string
		AddedZero bool
	}{Tool: "tool"}
	old := tighteningValueMode(reflect.ValueOf(oldSchema), nil, true)
	new := tighteningValueMode(reflect.ValueOf(newSchema), nil, true)
	if tighteningDigest(old) != tighteningDigest(new) {
		t.Fatal("new zero-valued schema field changed custom raw input identity")
	}
	newSchema.AddedZero = true
	if tighteningDigest(old) == tighteningDigest(tighteningValueMode(reflect.ValueOf(newSchema), nil, true)) {
		t.Fatal("nonzero custom input field was discarded")
	}
}
